Go module `github.com/bide-ai/bide`; [all packages](index.md).

`github.com/bide-ai/bide/schema` · [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bide-ai/bide/schema) · Stability: **core**

Package schema derives JSON Schema from Go types and emits provider-specific dialects.

**Variables**

- `var ErrGeminiUnsupported`: ErrGeminiUnsupported reports a schema Gemini's schema subset cannot express without changing which documents it admits (a map, an unconstrained value, an object with no properties).
- `var ErrStrictUnsupported`: ErrStrictUnsupported reports a schema OpenAIStrict cannot express in strict mode without changing which documents it admits (a map, a recursive type, a free-form object).
- `var ErrUnsupportedType`: ErrUnsupportedType reports a Go type For cannot describe: a document valid under any schema for it would fail to decode, so For refuses the type rather than emit such a schema.

**Functions**

- `func For[T any]() (json.RawMessage, error)`: For derives an inline JSON Schema from Go type T.
- `func Gemini(neutral json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)`: Gemini transforms a neutral schema into the OpenAPI 3.0 subset Gemini reads in a function declaration's parameters and in responseSchema:
- `func OpenAIStrict(neutral json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)`: OpenAIStrict transforms a neutral schema into OpenAI structured-output "strict" form, which closes every object (additionalProperties:false) and lists every property in required.
